Use case: ui-mockup, controlled edit of an actual implemented application screenshot.
EDIT TARGET: The supplied screenshot is the REAL implemented NEXG Money preview. This screenshot, not the earlier generated concept pictures, is the design authority. Preserve its pixel dimensions, framing, 276px dark sidebar, exact small gold NEXG logo, navigation icon shapes, sidebar spacing, Money selected background and yellow left accent, 72px top header, cream canvas, typefaces, font sizes, fine beige borders, white panels, button dimensions, tabs, two-column statement table / right-inspector layout, and existing positions. DO NOT redesign, modernize, invent a new header, add a KPI strip, change the sidebar to the earlier concept style, create a slide or add device/browser frames.
Keep the exact sidebar items Home, Work, Offerings, Availability, Business, Money, Promotions, Insights, Settings. Keep Merchant workspace, Sample preview, Choose sample state, Westlands location selector, bell, Help, and avatar in their existing header positions. The same fictional merchant is Nairobi Collective, Westlands, owner initials ZM. Change the avatar's data from NC to ZM only, without changing its style or position. Label the existing footer "Nairobi Collective · Westlands · Sample snapshot". Existing offering selector becomes "Groceries · standard · published"; fulfillment selector stays "Customer collection". Retain the exact Money title, subtitle "Understand your sales and settlement.", Sample specialty and Export buttons, and tabs Overview, Transactions, Payouts, Statements with ONLY Statements selected.
FICTIONAL CASE BASED ON THE EXISTING MONEY SAMPLE: Use the source's sample date 3 Nov2026, EAT, and period1–3Nov2026; do not pass it off as today's real date. Selected statement STM-1103, currencyKES, Westlands. The second statement row is STM-TODAY for3Nov2026, NOT selected. Original statement has36postings, posted sales KES200,000, confirmed refunds KES10,000, posted fees KES8,000, and net payable in period KES182,000. Net collections are190,000 but need not be displayed. These exact existing sample statement figures are NOT actual merchant money, a new tariff or a payout promise.
Two EXISTING sample fee records: TX-6400,1Nov2026, debit KES6,800; TX-6116,3Nov2026, debit KES1,200. Those sum to the original8,000fees. The owner SUSPECTS TX-6116 repeats a component included in TX-6400; do not present that suspicion as proven in the first two images. The later FICTIONAL proposed Finance investigation confirms that one1,200component already included in TX-6400 was duplicated by TX-6116; it posts reversal RV-6116 for+KES1,200. This is a hypothetical case extension, not an existing source fact. Valid remaining fees are6,800, comprising the original1,200fee plus other5,600fees within TX-6400. Retain TX-6116 and its reversal separately in history.
New fictional case reference FIN-1103. A submitted case never changes figures. Only the confirmed posted reversal and refreshed statement revision change fees8,000to6,800 and period net payable182,000to183,200. Sales200,000, customer refunds10,000 and net collections190,000 remain unchanged. Corrected report has37postings including the reversal. This is a FEE REVERSAL, not a customer refund. Do not imply customer/order completion, payout sent, money received, or new eligible payout balance. The existing eligible payout balance30,000 is outside this view and must not be recalculated here.
No personal customer names, phones, email, private addresses or credentials are needed. Keep Sample preview visible in every image. Readable text with natural word spacing is essential. Add only the narrowly scoped proposed investigation controls described below, inside existing panels.
IMAGE07: STATEMENT DISCREPANCY, BEFORE SUBMISSION. Timestamp3Nov2026,09:45EAT in the existing footer/source note.
Keep the original two statement-list rows and original table geometry. Select/highlight STM-1103 instead of STM-TODAY. First row coverage "1–3 Nov2026", format "CSV report", status "Available". Second row STM-TODAY coverage "3 Nov2026", formatCSVreport, statusAvailable.
The old transient "Sample statement report downloaded." banner becomes "Statement STM-1103 selected." in the SAME existing notice slot. Keep the second existing guidance notice in place.
The existing right inspector stays titled "Sample report", Available badge. Show "1–3 Nov2026 · Westlands · KES", "Report reference STM-1103", "Records included36", "FormatCSV", then its existing pair-row style: Posted sales KES200,000; Confirmed refunds KES10,000; Posted fees KES8,000. Add ONE comparable pair "Net payable in period KES182,000". Keep a brief sample-document caveat, and do not label it paid.
In the unused lower white space of the LEFT statements card, below the original statement rows, add one modest bordered evidence section "Fee entries to check". Use the current table and type style. Two rows with columns Posting, Posted, Fee debit, Status: TX-6400 |1Nov2026|KES6,800|Posted; TX-6116 |3Nov2026|KES1,200|Posted. Small caption "2 fee entries shown ·36postings in statement". Merchant note explicitly labeled "Merchant note: Please check whether TX-6116 repeats a fee included in TX-6400." No automated diagnosis or confirmed error.
Keep the existing Download CSV report and View report details controls in the inspector. Add ONE outlined action in the SAME inspector action area "Report an issue". Avoid a giant new gold CTA or a new main section outside the established grid. Footer remains the original style with Nairobi Collective, Westlands, Sample snapshot, "Revision0 ·3Nov2026,09:45EAT".
All screenshot regions unrelated to the selected data and added evidence/action should remain as close to the real input screenshot as possible.
